# Settings

⌘, opens eight sections, Appearance to About.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Appearance, Fonts, New sessions and Updates answer the pointer.

## Appearance and Fonts

Appearance follows the system or pins light or dark, and the accent is one of seven: periwinkle, orchid, rose, amber, moss, jade or teal. Fonts has eight faces for the chat and four monospace faces for code and the terminal, all under the Open Font License, and one text size for all three.

## New sessions

Each agent’s mode, model and effort to begin with. The pills under the composer change them for one session.

## Composer, Terminal, Files

Each one’s own switches: which key sends and which languages are spell-checked; the terminal’s scheme, its cursor, and whether a selection copies itself; format on save and its formatters.

## Updates and About

Updates checks daily, or now, and installs the new version itself. About says which version this is and who makes it.
